fi-calloplesiops-altivelis.title: Marine Betta (Comet)
fi-calloplesiops-altivelis.summary: A dark, white-spotted fish with long flowing fins and a false eye on its dorsal fin; when it hides its head in a crevice, its tail end looks like a moray. It comes out mainly at dusk.
rows: About 8 in (Top Shelf adult size); wild record 20 cm (7.9 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore. Foods: mysis shrimp, krill, silversides, squid, chopped seafood, live ghost shrimp, live feeder shrimp
Indo-Pacific: Red Sea and East Africa to Tonga and the Line Islands
notes: Ignores corals, but small shrimp, small crabs and fish under about 3 in may be eaten.
New fish can refuse prepared food at first; live ghost shrimp can start it feeding, then switch to thawed frozen shrimp. Feed under dim light.
